sn7.17:1.2: _Navakammika_, “builder”. The causative form is used, _kārāpeti_. He was not a manual laborer, but someone who supervised others to get the work done.
sn7.17:3.2: Accept the reading _visukkha_, which is supported by SA2 96, 一切盡枯.
sn7.17:3.3: This verse plays on _vana_ (“jungle”) and _vanatha_, explained by the commentary as “undergrowth”, and applied in the sense of the tangles and “snarls” of craving.
